rationale: No supported optimization applies without violating a contraindication or lacking required preconditions. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) would add actions/cache@v4 for ~/.gradle/caches, but the workflow already uses gradle/gradle-build-action@v2, which includes built-in caching of the Gradle user home directory (~/.gradle); this matches the 'An equivalent cache already exists' contraindication. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) requires representative successful-duration history to set a safe timeout, but the CI history contains only a single run. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated for this publish/deployment workflow. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is inapplicable with no matrix. Other patterns require matrices, schedules, Bazel, or tracing infrastructure absent from this single-job publish workflow.
